groups.title: Linked and integrated compounds with valence
groups.proposal: Derive linked versus integrated structure from the typed matrix construction and derive compound valence from the embed predicate. Permit any typed intransitive or transitive embed; treat known matrix stems as convenience analyses, not as a whitelist that blocks another user-supplied matrix with an explicit compatible analysis.
groups.writingJob: Preserve the four embed-matrix valence combinations, let the embed determine compound valence, let the typed matrix construction determine linked or integrated structure, distinguish connective and connectiveless linking, and restrict NNC plus VNC compounds to integrated structure without gating open Source entry by example membership.

groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses the embed and matrix Results and supplies a matrix construction analysis when it is not already known. Linked versus integrated is exposed only if the same typed composition genuinely supports both; valence and ordinary type consequences are automatic.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse Embed, Matrix, and conditional Compound Type; built-in matrices may preselect an analysis for convenience but may not form a Source whitelist. Do not add controls for the four valence cells or derived compound valence.

groups.title: Connective-t foundation
groups.proposal: For a selected connective-t compound, automatically place the embed perfective plus zero preterit before connective t or ti and the matrix. Derive t before a vowel and ti before a consonant, keep matrix subject agreement outside the embed, and preserve the two licensed event-time readings without treating English auxiliary wording as grammar.
groups.writingJob: Build connective-t compounds from an owner-issued embed and typed matrix, select t or ti from matrix onset, use the canonical perfective embed with zero preterit, preserve matrix subject and embed valence, and keep completed-before-matrix and begun-before-continuing readings available.

groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses the connective-t construction and the intended embed and matrix. Only a genuinely ambiguous traditional form asks for connective-t versus causative analysis; the application derives perfective, zero tense, t or ti, subject, valence, and finite Result.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse Compound Type, Embed, Matrix, and a conditional Analysis choice for a truly ambiguous traditional form; do not add controls for t versus ti, supportive i, zero preterit, copied spellings, event chronology defaults, or examples.

groups.title: ca, nemi, and yāuh matrix compounds
